home.title: Home
home.emptyText: Fazasanj shows where your space went, why, and what you can safely remove.
home.promise1: Nothing is deleted without your permission.
home.promise2: You always see what will happen first.

prescan.fastDesc: Reads the drive's file table directly, the way WizTree does. Usually several times faster.
prescan.fastAdmin: Windows will ask for admin permission once. It is only used to read, never to change anything.
prescan.fastNotNtfs: Fast scan only works on NTFS drives. This drive uses {fs}, so we'll use the normal scan.
prescan.fastFolderOnly: Fast scan reads whole drives only. For a single folder the normal scan is the right choice.
prescan.fastUnavailable: Fast scan isn't available for this drive.
prescan.normalDesc: Works on any drive and needs no admin permission. Slower on a full drive, but just as accurate.
prescan.readOnly: Scanning only reads. Nothing on your drive changes.
prescan.cancelledNote: The scan was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

scan.busy: A scan is running. Cancel it first or wait until it finishes.

scanning.title: Scanning your files
scanning.readOnly: You can keep using your computer while we scan.

done.stale: You cleaned up after this scan, so some numbers are out of date. Scan again to see fresh numbers.

fallback.uac_refused: Fast scan needs admin permission. We used the normal scan instead. It's slower but just as accurate.
fallback.not_ntfs: This drive isn't NTFS, so fast scan can't read it. We used the normal scan instead. It's just as accurate.
fallback.helper_failed: The fast scanner stopped unexpectedly. We used the normal scan instead. It's slower but just as accurate.
fallback.timeout: The fast scanner took too long to answer. We used the normal scan instead. It's slower but just as accurate.

story.title: Here's what's on your drive

story.buckets: Most of the space goes to {list}.

story.noSafe: Nothing here can be removed without a second look, so we listed what needs your decision below.

decide.one: One more item needs your decision.

decision.title: Needs your decision
decision.subtitle: These are probably fine to remove, but it depends on you.
decision.manual: This one can only be handled by hand. Open it to see how.
decision.emptyText: Everything we found is either safe or better left alone.

heur.entrySubtitle: Things no rule knows about. These are smart guesses, so check them before removing.
heur.neverSafe: These are guesses based on patterns, not rules. They are never marked safe, so look before you remove.
heur.confidenceHint: How sure we are about this guess

duplicates.title: Duplicate files
duplicates.short: The same file saved in more than one place.
duplicates.long: Files that are exactly the same, byte for byte. We suggest which copy to keep.
duplicates.ifDeleted: The other copy stays, so you don't lose the file.

old_project.title: Old projects
old_project.short: Code projects you haven't opened in a long time.
old_project.long: Programming projects nobody touched in months. Their downloaded packages can be rebuilt later.
old_project.ifDeleted: Your code stays. The removed packages come back with one install command.

orphan.title: Apps you removed
orphan.short: Leftover data from programs that are no longer installed.
orphan.long: Folders left behind by programs you uninstalled.
orphan.none: No leftovers from removed apps were found.
orphan.ifDeleted: Usually nothing, unless you install the app again and want its old settings.

stale.title: Files you haven't touched in a year
stale.short: Big files nobody opened or changed in a long time.
stale.long: Big files and folders that haven't changed in a long time. Maybe you still need them, maybe not.
stale.none: Nothing big has been sitting untouched.
stale.ifDeleted: They go to the Recycle Bin. Only remove what you're sure you don't need.

growth.title: Growth
growth.subtitle: How your drives changed between scans.
growth.same: Since last scan, {name} stayed about the same.
growth.notEnough: Scan again later to compare. We need at least two scans.
growth.emptyText: Every scan saves a small snapshot, so next time you can see what grew.

flags.reparse: Link to another place (not counted twice)

details.title: Details
details.pick: Select something to see its details.

chart.hint: Click a box to go inside it.

denied.explain: Windows keeps some folders private, even from you. This is normal and they are usually system folders.

cleanup.reviewText: Here is exactly what will happen. Nothing is removed until you confirm.
cleanup.blockedReason: Protected. Fazasanj never removes this, whatever the settings.

blockedCount.one: 1 item is protected and will be skipped.
blockedCount.other: {count} items are protected and will be skipped.

cleanup.permanentForSafeHint: Only for items marked safe. They skip the Recycle Bin, so the space is free right away.
cleanup.restorePointHint: A safety net for system changes. Takes a minute.

confirmText.one: 1 item, {size} in total, will be cleaned:
confirmText.other: {count} items, {size} in total, will be cleaned:

cleanup.confirmRecycle: Items going to the Recycle Bin can be restored from there until you empty it.
cleanup.inUseSkipped: Files that are in use are skipped, never forced.
cleanup.emptyText: Add items from the scan results, then review them here.

recycle_same_drive.title: The Recycle Bin doesn't free space by itself
recycle_same_drive.text: Items moved to the Recycle Bin still sit on the same drive. The space is only freed after you empty the bin. That's the safe default, because you can still restore them.

needs_admin.title: Windows will ask for permission
needs_admin.text: Some steps change system folders, so Windows will show an admin prompt.

system_action.title: Some steps use Windows' own tools
system_action.text: System items are never deleted as files. We run the official Windows tool for them instead.

outside_sandbox.title: Outside the test folder
outside_sandbox.text: This is a development build, and some items are outside the test folder, so they will be skipped.

blocked.title: Protected item
blocked.text: This item is on the protected list and will be skipped.

methods.delete_contents: Contents are removed, the folder stays
methods.command: Handled with an official Windows tool
methods.open_app_setting: Cleaned from the app's own settings
methods.compact_vhdx: Virtual disk is compacted, nothing inside is lost
methods.manual_only: Can only be handled by hand

methodExplain.recycle: Moves it to the Recycle Bin. You can restore it from there.
methodExplain.recyclePermanent: Deletes it permanently. It does not go to the Recycle Bin.
methodExplain.delete_contents: Moves what's inside to the Recycle Bin and keeps the folder.
methodExplain.delete_contentsPermanent: Deletes what's inside permanently and keeps the folder.
methodExplain.command: Runs the official Windows tool for this. Nothing is deleted as a file.
methodExplain.open_app_setting: Opens the app's own setting so you can clean it there.
methodExplain.compact_vhdx: Shrinks the virtual disk file. Everything inside it stays.
methodExplain.manual_only: We can't do this for you. Follow the steps below.

dry.nothingRemoved: Nothing would be removed here. This step needs you or an app.
dry.summary: Dry run done. The real cleanup would free about {size}. Nothing was changed.

result.title: Cleanup finished
result.inBin: {size} went to the Recycle Bin. Empty the bin to get this space back.
result.restorePoint: A restore point was created first.
result.restorePointFailed: The restore point couldn't be created.

skipped.one: 1 file was in use and was skipped.
skipped.other: {n} files were in use and were skipped.

history.title: Cleanup history
history.subtitle: Every cleanup and dry run is recorded here.
history.emptyText: When you clean something, it shows up here with exactly what happened.

ai.noRule: No rule knows this item yet.
ai.addKeyFirst: Add an AI key in Settings

aiSettings.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace it
aiSettings.keySavedToast: Key saved in Windows Credential Manager.

settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultModeHint: You can switch any time from the top bar.
settings.staleMonthsHint: Files not changed for this long show up under Files you haven't touched.
settings.oldProjectMonthsHint: Code projects not touched for this long show up under Old projects.
settings.lowSpace: Warn when free space is below (GB)
settings.lowSpaceHint: Drives under this amount are marked in red.
settings.trayHint: Lets Fazasanj check your drives quietly in the background.
settings.weeklyHint: Once a week, tell me if a drive is getting full.
settings.dataDirHint: Snapshots, cleanup history and saved answers live here.
settings.sandboxHint: In development builds, cleanup only works inside this folder.

what.title: Welcome to Fazasanj
what.lead: Fazasanj shows where your disk space went and explains it in plain words.
what.p1: See what takes up space, from the biggest folders down to single files.
what.p2: Learn why each thing is big and what it's for.
what.p3: Find out what is safe to remove and what happens if you do.

safety.title: Your files are safe
safety.lead: Fazasanj never deletes anything without asking you.
safety.p1: Windows system files and your personal folders are on a protected list that can't be removed.
safety.p2: Before any cleanup you see exactly what will happen, and you can do a dry run first.
safety.p3: Every cleanup is recorded, and most items go to the Recycle Bin first.

ai.title: AI help is optional
ai.lead: The app works fully without AI. You can turn it on later if you want.
ai.p1: AI is off by default. You bring your own key from OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or Groq.
ai.p2: Only names, sizes and dates are sent. Never the contents of your files.
ai.p3: You'll see exactly what is sent before the first question.

about.description: A Windows disk analyzer that explains where your space went, why, what is safe to remove, and what happens if you remove it.
about.privacyText: Everything stays on your computer. AI is optional and gets metadata only.
about.offlineText: Works without internet. Fonts and data are all local.
